title: Former witch finds God under Bastrop’s Lost Pines
summary: Debra Grant moved from Austin to nearby Bastrop in 2003 with her future husband, Dean Pahlow. Within weeks, the couple would become born-again Christians. Grant relied on her faith years...
content: Debra Grant moved from Austin to nearby Bastrop in 2003 with her future husband, Dean Pahlow. Within weeks, the couple would become born-again Christians. Grant relied on her faith years later when her home burned down in the most destructive wildfire in Texas history. Source

title: The Texas trans advocacy texts and mailers were fake. Their impact is real, and hard to control
summary: Texts and pamphlets purportedly sent out by a Texas transgender advocacy group were soon debunked as fake. But the scheme highlights how hard it can be to stem the flow...
content: Texts and pamphlets purportedly sent out by a Texas transgender advocacy group were soon debunked as fake. But the scheme highlights how hard it can be to stem the flow of incessant political marketing during election season — and to reverse its harmful effects. Source

title: Texas Standard for Oct. 27, 2026: ‘Devil of Devils’ revisits two unsolved Southwest Texas killings
summary: Two brutal crimes separated by 15 years — the murder of a Mexican-American teenager in 1953 and the killing of a Mexican-American family in 1968 — have remained unresolved for...
content: Two brutal crimes separated by 15 years — the murder of a Mexican-American teenager in 1953 and the killing of a Mexican-American family in 1968 — have remained unresolved for decades. “Devil of Devils” examines the victims, possible suspects and the roles race, class and law enforcement played. title: Trump visits Lubbock and Corpus Christi as Republicans fight to hold Texas’ US Senate seat
summary: With just a week until Election Day, President Donald Trump is making his fourth trip to Texas this campaign season. At rallies in Lubbock and Corpus Christi, the president aims...
content: With just a week until Election Day, President Donald Trump is making his fourth trip to Texas this campaign season. At rallies in Lubbock and Corpus Christi, the president aims to boost Republican voter turnout and shore up support for U.S. Senate nominee Ken Paxton. Source
